title: 7 Signs a Godly Man Runs His Own Day
caption:
7 signs a godly man runs his own day, instead of just reacting to it.

He decides his first hour the night before, and knows what he's doing before he knows what he's avoiding. He says no to urgent things that were never actually his. He builds margin on purpose and ends work at a time, not a feeling. He checks his calendar before his phone, and he can tell you why today mattered before he falls asleep.

Your schedule is either yours or it's whoever texted you last.

#faith #discipline #godlymen #christianman #productivity #selfcontrol #manofgod
theme: He runs his life — his impulses don't control him.
